A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel method for identifying an embedding of a dynamical systems with linear dynamics, which can be updated online from sensory input.

we propose a method to learn an embedding of the system state space with linear Koopman dynamics from sensory data, which can be used to predict future states and control the dynamics of the original system.

a model learned from data can be updated online to improve its performance over time, and thus can be used for long-term prediction and feedback control.
a model of the dynamics can be learned from sensory input, which can then be used for prediction and control.
